summary: Re-verified the iteration_6 edge case (frontend only, 390x844, handyman token). Declining an offer opened directly by URL (/ticket/<id>) now shows the toast 'Declined — it's in your Missed list', lands on handyman-jobs-screen (URL /), the job appears under missed-section, the stale decline button is gone, and there is no GO_BACK console error. Regression check: opening the offer from the Jobs list (ticket-row-<id>) and declining goes back to Jobs, and the job moves from offers to missed-job-<id>. Accept sheet day chips read 'Mon 26', 'Tue 27', 'Wed 28'. All 3 test tickets were cancelled.

issues: After the decline redirect the Jobs screen is already scrolled down a little (the 'Hi Hank' header is partly cut off at the top under the toast). Minor, web only. It looks like the ticket screen's scroll position carries over.

action_items: Optional: scroll the Jobs screen to the top after the decline redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: ticket/[id].tsx:154 fix is correct: router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(handyman)'). The error-state header (line 94) and the main header back (line 108) still call router.back() without a canGoBack fallback. On a direct-URL open, tapping Back will hit the same GO_BACK-not-handled problem. Suggest the same fallback there.
seed_data_creation: 3 offers created via make_offer.py (f242d63b1fd4457e, 5da2042fc5144c2f, 244a2504170f4e3e); all cancelled afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) when running make_offer.py. Offers expire after 120s, so run the UI test right after creating one. The decline-confirm-confirm sheet button can report 'outside of viewport' during its slide-in animation. Wait about 1s, or click it with a JS click via locator.evaluate('e=>e.click()').
